title: plywood.yml
description: plywood's config. Each key wraps a chant setting; plywood sets chant's keys from it, so a ci. key is refused.
$comment: Generated from packages/plywood/src/config by scripts/build-schema.mjs; edit the group modules, then run npm run schema.

stacks.description: Each stack as project/stack. plywood init finds them when the key is absent.

dir.description: The directory holding the stack's Pulumi.yaml.

paths.description: Paths whose change previews the stack, beside its directory.

gate.description: The stack's gate, in place of the top-level gate.

backend.description: The backend URL. A plunge+ URL (plunge+file://, plunge+s3://) picks the plunge engine.

waves.description: Lists of stacks, updated in order; the first wave is the canary. One wave per environment when absent.

engine.description: pulumi or plunge. Absent, a plunge+ backend picks plunge, else chant reads PULUMI_BACKEND_URL and Pulumi.yaml.

backend.description: The backend URL. A plunge+ URL (plunge+file://, plunge+s3://) picks the plunge engine.

when.description: merge, or pull-request for /plywood up before merge.

requires.description: What an open pull request needs before /plywood up updates it. All four when absent. Only with when: pull-request.

when.description: preview, from the first preview, or up, from an update before merge or a /plywood lock comment.

grain.description: resource, one lock per resource, or stack, one lock per stack.

approval_rules.description: Role and quorum per stack glob. Read at base.

review_stacks.description: A stack per open pull request. Off when absent.

template.description: The stack whose config a review stack starts from, as project/stack.

name.description: The review stack's name; {number} is the pull request's number.

ttl.description: How long a review stack lives after its last update, such as 72h. chant's default when absent.

branches.description: Branch name to stack globs. A stack a glob matches updates from that branch alone.

labels.description: Pull request label to stack globs. A labelled pull request previews only the stacks its labels match.

forge.description: The forge the jobs talk to. Read from the repository's remote when absent.

url.description: The forge's base URL, for a self-hosted forge.

pulumi.description: The Pulumi CLI release the jobs run, such as 3.272.0: one for every stack, or a map of stack glob to release. plywood's image's release when absent.

plunge.description: The plunge release the jobs run, such as 0.1.0: one for every stack, or a map of stack glob to release. plywood's image's release when absent.

image.description: The image every job runs in, in place of plywood's: a reference pinned by digest, or a map with name and the plugins a prepared image carries.

name.description: The image reference, built FROM plywood-pulumi or plywood-plunge, pinned by digest.

plugins.description: Plugins the prepared image installs, as name@version or kind:name@version.

runners.description: The runner every job runs on: a label, a list of labels, or a GitHub runner group; or default, preview, up and drift each mapped to one. runs-on on GitHub and Forgejo, tags on GitLab.

policy.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

drift.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

identity.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

pulumi_cloud.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

notify.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

telemetry.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

reports.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

review.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

agent.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

control.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

env.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

pass.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

parallelism.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.

environments.description: Read by a later plywood; accepted as written.
